label: a baseball.
why: In this animated film a large white baseball with red stitched seams sits on a dirt pitcher's mound, filling the centre of the frame. The ball itself does not move; the interval starts after the dissolve that enlarges it (about 13.25 to 13.5 s) and ends before it dissolves into a globe at about 17.25 s, and a pale glow ring appears around it from 14.75 s.
